verdict.rationale: Bland's Pathways feature explicitly supports visual, no-code conversation design with branching, draft/staging/production states, node-level editing, and testbed for iteration — matching the core of the story. However, evidence is entirely docs-based with no independent/hands-on confirmation of the visual builder's usability, and details like drag-and-drop UX or explicit 'handoff' mechanics between agents are not clearly documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the visual builder UI, explicit documentation of agent-to-agent or human handoff within pathways.
